findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "4 de 4 tiendas abiertas ahora" above "Dayana"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 0% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 3 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 2112px at 11992px; 396px at 15168px; 400px at 17064px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Totto" (screen 11, 100% hidden); "Totto, de la mochila a la gorra" (screen 11, 100% hidden); "Parker y Sheaffer" (screen 11, 100% hidden); "Plumas para firmar lo importante" (screen 11, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Esta historia cabe en un cuarto" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "2010" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "Las vitrinas" (screen 3, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Totto"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Acrílicos" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
